reason: The price is nothing to me, but I'm not letting an unknown bot sit in my site groups reading every message and also sign it into my Google account. From abroad I'd also end up checking its misreads of faded handwritten nota myself, so I don't save much.
objection: A third-party bot with access to my work chats and my Google Drive. Who runs it, where does the chat data go, and what else can it see besides the receipts?
would_change_my_mind: A narrow Google permission limited to the one sheet and folder it creates, a clear data policy saying chat messages that aren't receipts are never stored, plus a free trial showing it reads my team's faded Indonesian nota correctly.
